C45071.observed: What was checked: whether choosing "Keep Editing" on the discard question really does bring you back to what you were typing. What happened: with "ZZAUTOTEST unsaved A" and a quantity of 2 in the row, the row was closed and the discard question appeared; choosing "Keep Editing" closed the question and put the row back exactly as it was - same description, same quantity, nothing lost and nothing to retype.

C45072.observed: What was checked: what "Discard Part" actually does, on a new part and on a change to an existing one. What happened: on a new part row, choosing "Discard Part" closed the row and the part was not added - it does not appear anywhere in the parts list afterwards. On an existing part being edited, the quantity had been changed from 2 to 7; choosing to discard closed the row and the part line went straight back to 2, its last saved value. In both cases nothing was written and nothing was left half-changed.

C45073.observed: What was checked: whether leaving the work order part-way through typing a part warns you first, and exactly what it says. What happened: with a part half entered, clicking "Schedule" in the top menu did not navigate. A question appeared first, headed "Leave without saving?", with the body "This part hasn't been added to the work order yet. Leaving will discard it." and two choices: "Stay on Work Order" and "Leave". "Stay on Work Order" was the one already selected, so pressing Enter by reflex keeps you where you are and keeps your typing.

C45076.observed: What was checked: whether an untouched row is closed straight away rather than asking a pointless question. What happened: a new row was opened and nothing was typed into it; using the row's close control shut it immediately, with no confirmation of any kind. There was nothing entered that could be lost, so there was nothing to ask about.

C45077.observed: What was checked: whether an open but empty row gets in the way of leaving the page. What happened: a new row was opened and left untouched, then "Schedule" was clicked in the top menu. The page changed straight to the schedule with no question asked and nothing held up - an empty row is not treated as unsaved work.

C45082.observed: What was checked: whether choosing "Leave" really does both things - throw the part away and take you where you asked to go. What happened: with a part half entered, "Schedule" was clicked and the leave question appeared; choosing "Leave" took the browser straight to the schedule page, and the half-entered part was gone - it was never added to the work order.

C45083.observed: What was checked: whether choosing "Stay on Work Order" cancels the move and hands you back to the row you were filling in. What happened: the leave question was answered with "Stay on Work Order". The browser stayed on the work order's Lines page, the row was still open showing "ZZAUTOTEST unsaved nav" and its quantity of 3 untouched, and the cursor was put back into the Description box so typing could carry on where it stopped.
